sentences.text:
The present petition has been filed seeking the following reliefs :-
"(i) Issue a writ in the nature of mandamus directing the Respondent authorities to grant the benefit of rehabilitation and resettlement scheme under the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013 to the petitioner.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement (RFCTLARR) Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: (ii) Issue any other writ, order or direction as this Hon'ble Court deems fit."
Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that a representation has been filed by the petitioner which is pending consideration and has not been decided till date.
An innocuous prayer is made to direct the respondent No.2 to consider and decide the pending representation expeditiously.
Learned Government Advocate has no objection to the innocuous prayer made by the petitioner.

In such circumstances, this petition is disposed off by directing the petitioner to file a certified copy of this order before the respondent No.2, NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:43097 2 Abhinendra Singh Parmar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139932820/
1 WP-35020-2025 who in turn is directed to consider and decide the pending representation taking into consideration all the documents filed by the petitioner, within a period of 90 days from the date of receipt of certified copy of this order and communicate the outcome to the petitioner.
